title: ⚖️ ABRAHAM vs THE ARGUMENT
paragraphs: Abraham believed God — and it was credited to him as righteousness (Genesis 15:6).
Later, that belief was demonstrated when he obeyed (Genesis 22).
James the Just: “Faith without works is dead.” (James 2:17)
Does obedience save you — or reveal you?

Salvation is not earned by works.
But real faith is never alone.

Fire doesn’t create gold.
It reveals it.

Works don’t replace faith.
They expose whether it’s alive.
“Do works complete faith — or expose it?”

Drop your perspective below 👇
Let’s reason together, not argue.
